old_caption: The video depicts a woman performing a stretching exercise in a minimalist indoor setting. She stands on a colorful yoga mat placed on a plain concrete floor against a white wall. The woman is dressed in a teal sports bra and white leggings, with her long blonde hair tied back. She holds a resistance band above her head with both hands, extending it fully to stretch her arms and upper body. She then slowly lowers the band to her head/upper back area, holding it there. To her left, there is a green kettlebell and a small gray dumbbell, while to her right, two pink dumbbells are scattered on the floor.
original_wisa_caption: The video depicts a woman performing a stretching exercise in a minimalist indoor setting. She stands on a colorful yoga mat placed on a plain concrete floor against a white wall. The woman is dressed in a teal sports bra and white leggings, with her long blonde hair tied back. She holds a resistance band above her head with both hands, extending it fully to stretch her arms and upper body. After holding the stretch for a moment, she lowers the band down to her waist level, then raises it again, repeating the motion several times. To her left, there is a green kettlebell and a small gray dumbbell, while to her right, two pink dumbbells are scattered on the floor. The scene remains static throughout the video, focusing solely on the woman's exercise routine without any additional movement or changes in the environment.
caption: The video depicts a woman filmed from behind, standing feet apart on a yoga mat in a plain white studio. A green foam roller and kettlebell rest against the wall to the left, while pink and yellow dumbbells lie on the floor to the right. She wears a teal sports top and light gray leggings, gripping a gray band with her right arm raised overhead and her left hand at her upper back. Her right arm slowly flexes at the elbow, lowering the gripping hand from overhead toward the back of her head and then behind her neck. As that hand descends, the visible band between the hands shortens and tilts, passing close to her head instead of hanging straight down. Her left hand stays fixed at her shoulder blade while her torso, legs, and feet remain stationary, the body neither translating nor rotating. The camera and equipment hold their positions, framing the steady movement of the single arm.
